paite: Huan Nun tapa Joshua in, "Agam leh Jeriko khua va en mah dih ua," chi in mi nih Sittim a pan asim a enkhe ding asawl hi. Ava hoh ua, kizuak khat, amin Rahab inn ah ava lut ua, huai ah ava zintung uhi.
heading: Joshua In Jeriko Ahvolirl Enkhe mite Asawl

paite: "Ngai in, tuzan in gam enkhe ding in Israel suante ahong uh," chi in Jeriko kumpipa hilh in a-om hi.
Jeriko kumpipa'n, "Na inn a hong tung mikhualte hon pekhia in. Gam pumpi enkhe ding a hong ahi uh," chỉ ding in Rahab kiang ah mi asawl hi.
Numei in huai mi nihte api a, asel a, akiang uah, "Hi, ka kiang ah mite ahong ngei ngut ua, himahleh koi a pan hong pai ahi ua, chih zaw ka thei kei.
heading: Enkhia Mi Nihte Humbitnar

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, khomial, kulh kongpi khak hun lai in huai mite apawtkhe nawnta uh. Koilam ah ahia apai uh ka theita kei hi. Delh meng le uchin, na pha lai ding uh,” achi hi.
Himahleh inn tung ah apitou a, inn tung a ziza kung siatkhawm lak a sel khin lah ahi ngal a.
Mite'n Jordan lui lam ah, agalkaina tan in ava delh ua; adelh mite apawtkhiaktak un kulh kongpi akhak uhi.
Alup ma un inn tung ah akiang uah ava hohtou hi.
heading: Enkhemite Lohchinna

paite: Akiang uah, "Hiai gam TOUPA'N nou ahon peta, na lauhhuaina un hon delhkhum a, hiai gam a teng tengteng na ma uah azul khin uh, chih ka thei hi.

Aigupta gam a pan na hong pawtkhiak un TOUPA'N Tuipi San ahon hihkangsak a, Jordan lui gal a Amorte kumpi nih: Sihon leh Og tung a na hihdante uh, huchibang a na hihmangdante uh lah ka na zata ngal ua.
Huai ka na zaktak un, ka lungtangte uh azul khin a, noute ziak a lau lou himhim a-om kei hi. TOUPA na Pathian u lah tunglam van ah leh nuailam lei ah Pathian ahi.
"Tu in na tung uah ka hehpihna ka langsakta hi, nou leng ka pa inkote tung ah na hehpihna uh langsak sam un.
heading: Enkhe mite Leh Rahab Thukhun

paite: Ka nu leh ka pa, ka sanggam pasalte, ka sanggam numeite leh aneih teng uh hawi unla, sihna lak a pan ka hinna uh hon humbitsak ding in TOUPA min in hehpih in ka kiang ah kichiam unla, chiamtehna dik hon pia un," achi hi.

Mite'n akiang ah, "Ka thilhih uh na genkhiak kei dingleh na sih tang in ka si ding uh. Huan hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA'N gam ahon piak hun chiang in, ka hon hehpih ding ua, na tung ah muanhuaitak in ka hih ding uh," achi uhi.
Tohlet ah khauhual azankhesuk a; khopi kulhbaang khou a a-inn om ahi a, huan amah kulhbaang tung a teng ahi.

Akiang uah, "Tang lam zuan in pai un, huchi lou in zaw nou hon delhte'n ahon mu kha ding uh. Huai ah ni thum sung va kibu un; nou hon delhte ahong kik nawn masiah uh. Huai zoh chiang in na pai nawn na ding uh," achi hi.
Mite'n akiang ah, "Kichiamna a na hon kichiamsakna ah zaw dembei ka hi ding uh.
Ngai in, hiai gam ka hong lut chiang un na hon khiakna tohlet ah hiai khau san na gak belh în. Insung ah na kiang ah na pa, na nu, na sanggam teng leh na pa inkote tengteng pilut vek in.

Huan hichi ahi ding a, na inn kongpi a pan kholak a pawtkhe peuhmah alutung ah asisan a-om dia, kou ahihleh moh in ka om kei ding uh. Kuapeuh insung a na kiang a om peuhmah atung ua khutkhak ahihleh, ka lutung uah asisan uh a-om ding hi.
Himahleh ka thilhih uh na genkhiakleh na hon kichiamsakna ah moh in ka om kei ding uh," achi uhi.
Ama'n, "Na thu bang zel uh hi hen," achi a; huchi in amau akhakhia a, apaita uhi. Tohlet ah khau san agakden hi.
Apai ua, huai tang ava tung ua, huai ah ni thum, amau delhte akik nawn masiah uh ava om uhi. Adelh mite'n lamtawn in azong ua, himahleh amuzou kei uh.
heading: Enkhe mite Paikikna

paite: Huai mi nihte akik nawn ua, huai tang a pan apaisuk ua, agalkah ua, Nun tapa Joshua kiang atung ua; atung ua thil tung tengteng ahilh uhi.
Joshua kiang ah, "TOUPA'N agam pumpi i khut uah ahon na pe petmah ve, huai kia leng hilou, huai gam a tengte i ma uah azul khin uh," achi uhi.
